33 class IRadarMsg
34 {
35 /****************************** ENUMS *******************************/
36
37 public:
41 enum MessageType : uint8_t
42 {
43 NONE = 0,
44 // enumeration values, which are sent in messages received from HRVS:
45 MINRANGE = 1,
46 OBJECT_INFO = 3,
47 FILTEREDPOINT = 4,
48 ACK = 5,
49 // enumeration values used just by radar system:
50 CONFIG_MSG,
51 MEASUREMENT_START_MSG,
52 CONTROL_MSG
53 };
54
58 enum RadarProtocolVersion
59 {
60 PROTOCOL_VER_1_0 = 10,
61 PROTOCOL_VER_1_1 = 11
62 };
63
64 /**************************** CONSTANTS *****************************/
65
66 public:
67 static constexpr unsigned SYNC_WORD_LENGTH = 4;
68 static constexpr uint8_t SYNC_WORD[SYNC_WORD_LENGTH] = {0xA9, 0xB8, 0xC7, 0xD6};
69 static constexpr unsigned CHSUM_LENGTH = 2;
70 static constexpr uint8_t UNDEFINED_MSG_RADAR_ID = 0;
71 static constexpr uint16_t UNDEFINED_MSG_RADAR_FRAME = -1;
72 static constexpr char* MESSAGE_NAME[] = {
73 (char*)"UNKNOWN MESSAGE TYPE",
74 (char*)"MINRANGE MESSAGE",
75 (char*)"UNKNOWN MESSAGE TYPE",
76 (char*)"OBJECT INFO MESSAGE",
77 (char*)"FILTERED POINT MESSAGE",
78 (char*)"CONFIG ACKNWOLEDGMENT MESSAGE",
79 (char*)"CONFIG MESSAGE",
80 (char*)"MEASUREMENT START MESSAGE",
81 (char*)"CONTROL MESSAGE"
82 };
83
84 /************************ INTERFACE METHODS *************************/
85
86 public:
92 virtual MessageType getMsgId() const = 0;
93
99 virtual const char* getMsgName() const = 0;
100
107 virtual unsigned getMsgLength() const = 0;
108
114 virtual uint16_t getRadarFrame() const = 0;
115
116#ifdef MSG_LOGGING
124 friend std::ostream &operator<<(std::ostream &out, const IRadarMsg &message)
125 {
126 message.print(out);
127 return out;
128 }
129
130 protected:
136 virtual void print(std::ostream &out) const = 0;
137
138 public:
139 // items always printed before message items when logging message
140 unsigned logSystemFrameNumber;
141 long long logLastMeasTriggerTime;
142#endif // #ifdef MSG_LOGGING
143 };

288 template<typename PAYLOAD_ITEM_TYPE, int MAX_PAYLOAD_ITEMS>
289 class RadarPayloadOutputAbstract : public IRadarPayloadOutput

291 public:
292
293 /***************************** METHODS ******************************/
294
302 PAYLOAD_ITEM_TYPE& operator[](unsigned i)
303 {
304 if(i >= 0 && i < getPayloadItemsCount())
305 {
306 return payloadItems[i];

308 else
309 {
310 // return first item, in case invalid index is entered
311 return payloadItems[0];
312 }
313 };
314
322 const PAYLOAD_ITEM_TYPE& operator[](unsigned i) const
323 {
324 if(i >= 0 && i < getPayloadItemsCount())
325 {
326 return payloadItems[i];
327 }
328 else
329 {
330 // return first item, in case invalid index is entered
331 return payloadItems[0];
332 }
333 };
334
335 /************************ INSTANCE VARIABLES ************************/
336
337 protected:
338 PAYLOAD_ITEM_TYPE payloadItems[MAX_PAYLOAD_ITEMS];
339 };
